rows.Benefits Description: If you receive care for your accidental injury within 72 hours, we cover: • Treatment in an outpatient facility or in the outpatient/emergency room department of a hospital • Related outpatient physician care • Related diagnostic services Note: Emergency room charges associated directly with an inpatient admission are considered 'Other charges' under Inpatient hospital b enefits in Section 5(c) and are not part of this benefit, even though an accidental injury may be involved. This provision also applies to dental care required as a result of accidental injury to sound natural teeth.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 5% of the Plan allowance, plus the difference between the billed amount and the Plan allowance

rows.Benefits Description: Not covered: • Oral implants and transplants; including for the treatment of accidental injury • Masticating (chewing) incidents are not considered to be accidental injuries.

Outpatient medical or surgical services and supplies billed by a hospital for emergency room treatment. Notes: • We will provide in-network benefits if you are admitted to an out-of- network hospital due to a medical emergency. • We will also provide in-network benefits for professionals who provide services in an out-of-network hospital, when admitted due to a medical emergency.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 5% of the Plan allowance

rows.Benefits Description: Outpatient medical services and supplies billed by an urgent care facility. Note: This applies only to urgent care facilities, not providers that offer urgent care or after-hours services.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount
